title: Case 04: The Midnight Train
subtitle: A judge vanishes from a sleeper train. A body is found in the baggage carriage, but it is not the judge.
loop_reset_text: The train enters the mountain tunnel. Midnight strikes. The rails scream backward to 11:25 PM.

lounge.name: Observation Lounge
lounge.description: Dark mountains slide beyond the glass. Every passenger watches everyone else without admitting it.

sleeper.name: Sleeper Car
sleeper.description: Compartment doors, tea trays and two room keys that should never have been exchanged.

baggage.name: Baggage Car
baggage.description: A dead passenger lies among trunks. The murderer believed this was Judge Hale.

service.name: Maintenance Passage
service.description: A narrow corridor beneath the sleeper section hides access panels and a concealed compartment.

clara.name: Clara Hale
dialogue: He switched rooms after receiving a coded note.
I begged him to leave the train at the last station.

contradiction.result: Clara knew about the compartment switch and concealed it to protect her father.

anton.name: Anton Voss
dialogue: I have nothing to gain from killing a judge.
I paid for information about his carriage. I did not order a murder.

contradiction.result: Anton financed surveillance of Hale, but the baggage claim trail points to someone with official access.

gabriel.name: Father Gabriel
dialogue: It contains documents the judge asked me to carry.
Those documents name a compromised police officer.

contradiction.result: Gabriel's sealed package contains backup evidence, not a weapon.

rowan.name: Inspector Rowan
dialogue: Judge Hale never left his compartment.
The conductor's master key is the only way into the service passage.

contradiction.result: The master-key access, coded message and drugged tea show Rowan knew about the room switch and targeted the wrong passenger.

selene.name: Selene Marr
dialogue: I knew Hale had evidence but not where he hid it.
I saw Rowan carry tea toward compartment 6 after the switch.

contradiction.result: The drugged tea supports Selene's account and places Rowan at the false target compartment.

nikolai.name: Nikolai Finch
dialogue: My master key never leaves me.
The service compartment can hide a person for hours.

contradiction.result: The copied key signature clears Nikolai of direct access while revealing the judge's hiding place.

keys.name: Swapped Compartment Keys
keys.description: Two passenger keys were exchanged shortly before the murder.

paper.name: Torn Legal Document
paper.description: A document names Anton's company but also references a police leak.

claim.name: Baggage Claim Ticket
claim.description: The dead passenger's trunk was redirected using an escort credential.

masterkey.name: Copied Master-Key Signature
masterkey.description: A copied conductor credential opened the service passage.

tea.name: Drugged Tea
tea.description: A sedative was delivered to the compartment the murderer believed belonged to Hale.

compartment.name: Hidden Maintenance Compartment
compartment.description: Judge Hale is alive, hiding beneath the sleeper car.

message.name: Coded Newspaper Message
message.description: The message reveals the room switch to someone using a police cipher.

package.name: Sealed Evidence Package
package.description: Documents identify a compromised escort officer and duplicate Hale's evidence.

timeline: 11:25 PM — Hale boards under police escort.
11:34 PM — Clara receives a coded warning.
11:48 PM — Drugged tea is delivered to the wrong room.
11:53 PM — Copied master key opens service access.
11:57 PM — Wrong passenger is moved to baggage car.
12:00 AM — Train enters tunnel and loop resets.
deduction_prompt: Who knew about the compartment switch and killed the wrong passenger while trying to reach Judge Hale?
truth: Inspector Rowan was the compromised escort. He learned of Hale's compartment switch through a police cipher, copied the conductor's master-key signature and drugged the wrong passenger, believing him to be the judge. Hale survived by hiding in the maintenance compartment.
partial: You expose Rowan but fail to prove Hale survived or how the wrong victim was selected.
wrong: Your theory cannot explain the swapped keys, the drugged tea and the hidden judge. Midnight returns.
